title: Will it help the prompt?
instruction: You want a better picture for a poster. What will help in the prompt, and what won’t?

items.why: A specific word that changes the result.
Neither politeness nor capitals make the picture better.
Light is one of the strongest parameters.

items.text: Change five words at once and hope
items.why: Then you don’t know which word did what.
The shot decides what will be visible in the picture.
The generator doesn’t know what “well” means to you.
The mood affects the colours and the light.

debrief: A generator reads only words, so specific parameters help: style, light, shot, mood. Pleading and changing five things at once don’t.
